speaker: Unknown
en: Today we cover how Codex started and why it was built in Rust and made open source.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: This episode is presented by TurboBuffer, a ridiculously scalable fast and cheap hybrid search engine built on top of object storage by an engineering team that I've really grown to like after spending time with them.
zh: 本期节目由 TurboBuffer 呈现，这是一个可扩展性极强、快速且廉价的混合搜索引擎，构建在对象存储之上，来自一个我在与他们相处后真正产生了好感的工程团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: TurboBuffer is the tool that companies like Anthropic, Notion, Cognition, and Harvey all use to connect their AI products to massive amounts of unstructured data.
zh: TurboBuffer 是 Anthropic、Notion、Cognition 和 Harvey 等公司用来将他们的 AI 产品连接到海量非结构化数据的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I've talked with engineers who use TurboBuffer, the theme that always comes up is reliability and performance at scale.
zh: 当我和使用 TurboBuffer 的工程师交谈时，总是出现的主题是规模化下的可靠性和性能。

speaker: Unknown
en: The reasons for this have everything to do with TurboBuffer's architecture.
zh: 其原因与 TurboBuffer 的架构有很大关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: TurboBuffer uses only object storage for state and NVMe SSDs with memory cache for compute.
zh: TurboBuffer 只用对象存储来做状态，用带内存缓存的 NVMe SSD 来做计算。

speaker: Unknown
en: Data and TurboPuffer is organized into namespaces.
zh: TurboPuffer 中的数据被组织成命名空间。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can think of a namespace as a database table or a search index or an S3 prefix depending on the world you come from.
zh: 你可以把命名空间想象成一张数据库表、一个搜索索引或一个 S3 前缀，取决于你来自哪个世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: When a namespace is not being queried it stays on cheap object storage with no associated compute cost.
zh: 当一个命名空间没有被查询时，它就留在廉价的对象存储上，没有相关的计算成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: When a namespace is active, TurboPuffer pulls it up into hot-catching tiers, so queries are very fast.
zh: 当一个命名空间活跃时，TurboPuffer 会把它拉到热缓存层，所以查询非常快。

speaker: Unknown
en: This design fundamentally makes it effortless to scale to hundreds of millions of namespaces.
zh: 这种设计从根本上使得扩展到数亿个命名空间毫不费力。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're building a multi-tenant AI product, every user and their agent can have their own dedicated search index without any overhead.
zh: 如果你在构建一个多租户 AI 产品，每个用户和他们的智能体都可以拥有自己专属的搜索索引，没有任何开销。

speaker: Unknown
en: And each namespace can hold hundreds of millions of documents without any special configuration.
zh: 而且每个命名空间可以在没有任何特殊配置的情况下容纳数亿份文档。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can scale TurboPuffer virtually without limit and the performance, reliability, and operating model all stay the same.
zh: 你几乎可以无限制地扩展 TurboPuffer,而性能、可靠性和运维模式都保持不变。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you need to connect AI to lots of data, TurboPuffer should be your first choice.
zh: 如果你需要把 AI 连接到大量数据，TurboPuffer 应该是你的首选。

en: Check it out at turbopuffer.com slash pragmatic.
